notes: Eval 1 is a pipeline run against the shared tinytask fixture: `design` runs with autonomous decisions authorized on the well-specified issue, on the current branch, and stops after the spec. It grades the spec draft in the git directory as the issue's new body with nothing committed, its form, and the code map beside it, named after it. The three required files are fixture knowledge (#354 D6): the issue decides about the command-line module, the model module that enumerates the states, and the command-line test module.

evals.name: design-leaves-a-code-map
evals.prompt:
Use the `design` skill to design `issues/001-well-specified.md`.

Resolve once into a retained ResolvedProject. The tracker capability is unsupported, so this file is the issue; refusal is fatal and no value is defaulted or inferred. Work on the current branch without a worktree. I authorize you to make every design decision yourself within this issue's scope: post no question round and wait for nothing. Produce the design spec only; do not edit `tinytask/` or `tests/`.

**Stop after the design.** Do not grill, plan or implement. Report the spec path.
evals.expected_output: One design spec draft under the git directory's specs directory, whose Decisions section names modules and behavior without file paths or line numbers. The issue file is rewritten to equal the draft with its Acceptance criteria section unchanged, no commit is made, and nothing else in the working tree changes. A code map beside the draft, named after it with `.code-map.md` in place of `.md`: one entry per module the spec decides about, each with a Why line and a Code line of tracked paths, covering `tinytask/cli.py`, `tinytask/model.py` and `tests/test_cli.py`. No code map is tracked or present in the working tree, and no source or test file is touched.

asserts.name: the spec is the issue's body, drafted in the git directory, and nothing was committed
asserts.shell: spec=; for f in "$SPEC_DIR"/*.md; do case "$f" in *.code-map.md) ;; *) [ -e "$f" ] && { spec=$f; break; } ;; esac; done; [ -n "$spec" ] || { fail "no spec draft under $SPEC_DIR"; exit 1; }; cmp -s "$spec" "$REPO/issues/001-well-specified.md" || { fail "the issue body is not the spec draft"; exit 1; }; [ "$(awk '/^## /{p=($0=="## Acceptance criteria")} p' "$REPO/issues/001-well-specified.md")" = "$(git -C "$REPO" show "$BASE_MAIN:issues/001-well-specified.md" | awk '/^## /{p=($0=="## Acceptance criteria")} p')" ] || { fail "the issue's acceptance criteria section changed"; exit 1; }; no_new_commits "$REPO" || exit 1; [ "$(git -C "$REPO" status --porcelain)" = " M issues/001-well-specified.md" ] || { fail "the working tree holds more than the issue's new body: $(git -C "$REPO" status --porcelain | tr '\n' ' ')"; exit 1; }

asserts.name: the spec's Decisions section names no file path or line number
asserts.shell: spec=; for f in "$SPEC_DIR"/*.md; do case "$f" in *.code-map.md) ;; *) [ -e "$f" ] && { spec=$f; break; } ;; esac; done; [ -n "$spec" ] || { fail "no spec under $SPEC_DIR"; exit 1; }; spec_decisions_path_free "$spec" "$REPO"

asserts.name: the code map sits beside the spec draft, named after it
asserts.shell: spec=; for f in "$SPEC_DIR"/*.md; do case "$f" in *.code-map.md) ;; *) [ -e "$f" ] && { spec=$f; break; } ;; esac; done; [ -n "$spec" ] || { fail "no spec under $SPEC_DIR"; exit 1; }; map="${spec%.md}.code-map.md"; [ -f "$map" ] || fail "no code map at $map"

asserts.name: the code map is well-formed and lists the three files the issue decides about
asserts.shell: spec=; for f in "$SPEC_DIR"/*.md; do case "$f" in *.code-map.md) ;; *) [ -e "$f" ] && { spec=$f; break; } ;; esac; done; [ -n "$spec" ] || { fail "no spec under $SPEC_DIR"; exit 1; }; map="${spec%.md}.code-map.md"; code_map_valid "$map" "$REPO" tinytask/cli.py tinytask/model.py tests/test_cli.py

asserts.name: no code map is tracked or present in the working tree
asserts.shell: found=$(git -C "$REPO" ls-files -- '*.code-map.md'; find "$REPO" -name .git -prune -o -name '*.code-map.md' -print); [ -z "$found" ] || fail "a code map outside the git directory: $found"

asserts.name: the implementation was not started
asserts.shell: path_unchanged_since "$REPO" origin/main tinytask tests || exit 1; extra=$(git -C "$REPO" status --porcelain -- tinytask tests); [ -z "$extra" ] || fail "uncommitted or untracked files under tinytask or tests: $extra"
